title: 222쪽
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: Villain bets $120. Hero raises to $880 all-in. Villain calls.

Hero made a very disguised draw against a very strong range of hands, This is one of the rare situations where he should raise the turn instead of waiting until the river. Any 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, or spade will kill his action on the river. He should shove and expect to get paid by two pair or better.
